Firstly, I started the NTLM relaying process to the web enrollment interface on the domain controller using ntlmrelayx. This can also be done using certipy relay module. Since the target is the domain controller, I specified the template as Domain Controller:

└─$ ntlmrelayx.py -t http://10.0.28.231/certsrv/certfnsh.asp -smb2support --adcs --template DomainController
